decision: Treat Scripts level off-by-default as the ratified invocation policy, not as a failure to execute an action once invoked.
effective_source: §12.6.4.17 says the processor shall execute upon invocation. Scope ratifications A100/A286 make the host-supplied level the control for whether a script is invoked; A193 keeps the default off and requires a supplied runner for on. CLAUDE.md and doc/scope-ratifications.md say exactly this.
current_evidence: The engine path is present and tested when enabled. The worker path is real and tests are feature-gated. Off/no-runner tests assert no worker is started and refusals are reported. The scope exclusion is limited to effects that leave the process, mutate pdf_syntax::Document, 3D, and XFA.
residual: This does not certify all effects of ECMAScript or all members of the Adobe script API; those are bounded by A193's selected API surface and the document/viewer scope.

decision: Do not carry the old generic 'JavaScript out of scope' disposition into this review.
effective_source: Current CLAUDE.md scope and A286 ratification amend the boundary: document field values/appearances and viewer state are in scope, while process-external effects remain excluded. Current ledger row 12.6.4.17 is implemented.
current_evidence: ADR 1904 records accepted and built status and added the bookmark activation route. Current ledger cites bookmark action, name tree, OpenAction, page, annotation, form, document, off/on and worker tests.
residual: Older doc/errata-read passages that describe §12.6.4.17 as out-of-scope are historical ranking snapshots; use current ledger, scope ratifications and ADR successor evidence.

decision: Draft one integration test combining the already-covered Table 221 stream form with actual engine execution, without labeling its absence a confirmed behavior bug.
effective_source: Table 221 requires /JS as a text string or text stream containing the script to be executed. §12.6.4.17 separately requires execution upon invocation.
current_evidence: script_unread validates that a decoded stream is handed to the runner and that a direct string is recognized; engine hook tests execute real direct-string scripts and a persistent document realm. They do not combine these two paths.
residual: The two code paths appear shared after script_text decoding. Parent should run the proposed test with --features engine before claiming end-to-end stream execution; this agent did not run Cargo.
